jobs.title: Big-Event Security Pro: Flexible Hours, Weekly Pay
jobs.description:
Allied Universal® Event Services in Austin is hiring Event Security Officers to staff major sports, concerts, and festivals. You will check bags, control access, scan tickets, and help ensure a safe guest experience.

The role offers flexible part-time and full-time schedules with weekly pay and paid training. Applicants must be at least 18, have a high school diploma, and can pass a background check and drug/alcohol screening.

jobs.title: Event Security Specialist — VIP & Crowd Safety
jobs.description:
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, spanning Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. The role focuses on guest safety, conflict prevention, and assisting in emergencies at venues.

We seek individuals with strong English skills, physical stamina, and the ability to work late hours in a fast-paced live event environment. Bi-lingual candidates and EMT backgrounds are a plus.

jobs.title: Executive Event Security Lead
jobs.description:
A leading technology Company in Austin, TX is seeking an Event Security Manager to oversee security planning and execution for corporate events. This role demands strong experience in event security management and risk assessment, ensuring all security operations are aligned with company standards. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, the ability to coordinate across various stakeholders, and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.

Candidates must have significant experience in corporate security and event planning.
